newsitem.title: FRANCE: Valeo turns in strong first half.
newsitem.headline: Valeo turns in strong first half.

text.p: French car parts maker Valeo reported on Thursday a more than 30 percent jump in first-half operating income, helped by a strong sales performance.
Net profits in the six months to June 30 rose by 4.3 percent to 656 million French francs ($129 million) from 629 million ($123 million) a year earlier.
But stripping out an extraordinary capital gain of 130 million francs ($26 million) in the first half of 1995, profits rose by 31 percent, the company said.
"In the first half of 1996, the group exceeded its sales and operating margins growth targets," the company said in a statement.
Valeo Chairman Noel Goutard told a news conference that the company's sales rose 17 percent in the first eight months of the year to 19 billion francs ($3.7 billion).
